description: Page rendering layer: make the Accuracy History page (app/accuracy-checks/page.tsx) choose its Golden columns from the sport filter and read each check's value via a sport-correct reader that inspects the STORED shape. Applies the SAME rule to all three comparison tables (Saved checks, All analysts = AnalystComparisonTable, By location = LocationComparisonTable) plus the By-master-fixture table, the summary Stat cards, and the trend chart selector. Depends on FEAT-001's exported StoredAflPlayerAccuracy / player_accuracy union.
steps: Near the existing PLAYER_ACCURACY_COLUMNS (app/accuracy-checks/page.tsx ~line 180) add `AFL_PLAYER_ACCURACY_COLUMNS` = overall/scoring/defence/possession/disposals/other with labels Overall/Scoring/Defence/Possession/Disposals/Other and shorts OVR/SCO/DEF/POS/DIS/OTH, and `OVERALL_ONLY_COLUMNS = [{key:'overall',label:'Overall',short:'OVR'}]`. Export/derive a union key type. Keep all three arrays co-located so labels never drift.

Add a sport-correct reader `groupPctForCheck(check, key)`: read check.player_accuracy; if null return null; if it has `afl===true` return groupPct(pa.both?.[key]) only when key is a valid AFL key else null; otherwise (football shape) keep the existing `!pa.football -> null` guard then return groupPct(pa.both?.[key]) only when key is a valid football key else null. overall is valid on both shapes. This makes a legacy NULL-sport football-shaped row (filtered as 'afl') return null for AFL-only keys -> blank cells, which is correct until recompute.

Add an `activeColumns` memo keyed off sportFilter: 'football' -> PLAYER_ACCURACY_COLUMNS; 'afl' -> AFL_PLAYER_ACCURACY_COLUMNS; 'all' -> OVERALL_ONLY_COLUMNS. Thread it (and groupPctForCheck) through the Saved table, both comparison components, the fixture table, the Stat cards, and the trend selector.

Saved-checks table: drive the thead (~1344), body cells (~1429), the sortedSavedChecks `val` group cases (~590, replace the hardcoded overall/passing/.../other cases with: if key is in the active column set return groupPctForCheck(c,key)), and the CSV export header (~698) + cells (~711) off activeColumns + groupPctForCheck instead of PLAYER_ACCURACY_COLUMNS/storedGroupPct. Keep the Overall-column highlight. Update averageGroups/overallAverages (~244/~1043) and the History summary Stat cards (~1680) to iterate activeColumns and read via groupPctForCheck; build their output record from the active keys (not the hardcoded football literal).

analystComparison (~830) and locationComparison (~934) memos: iterate activeColumns, read each check via groupPctForCheck, and build the per-row `groups` record from the active keys (replace the hardcoded {overall,passing,offensive,defensive,goalkeeper,other} literals with a record built over activeColumns). Pass activeColumns into AnalystComparisonTable (~2957) and LocationComparisonTable (~3263) as a prop; use it for their thead, body cells (~3177 / ~3513 / ~3556), sort `val` (~915 sortedComparison and the location analyst-row sort ~3312), and each component's own CSV export (AnalystComparisonTable ~3024; LocationComparisonTable groupCols ~3359). Keep Overall highlight.

By-master-fixture table: generalise fixtureGroupAccuracy (~146) so its fast path returns the stored scope object for the correct shape (football OR AFL) rather than assuming football — detect `afl===true` vs `football`. Drive the fixture thead/body/tfoot (~1968/~2008) and sortFixtureRows (~1143) off activeColumns. For filter=all use OVERALL_ONLY_COLUMNS. Keep the legacy XML-fallback path computing football PlayerAccuracy for NULL rows (acceptable backward-compat path; those render Overall/football only).

Trend chart: drive the group-selector button list (~3216) off activeColumns; if sportFilter change removes the current trendGroup key from the active set, reset trendGroup (~516) to 'overall' (overall is always present).
acceptance_criteria: With sportFilter='football' all three tables + fixture table + Stat cards show Overall + Passing/Offensive/Defensive/Goalkeeper/Other with football values (unchanged from today).
With sportFilter='afl' they show Overall + Scoring/Defence/Possession/Disposals/Other reading AFL-shaped stored values; football-shaped or legacy-NULL rows render blank '—' for the AFL-only columns.

With sportFilter='all' only the Overall column is shown (the five sport-specific columns are dropped); non-golden columns (Ex/Mas, Disputes, Date, Match, Analyst, Master by, Category, Check #) are unchanged in every filter.
`npx tsc --noEmit` clean and `npm run build` succeeds.
findings:
DONE. All verification green in the worktree: `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; `npm run build` succeeds; `npm run test` = 168 passed (13 files); `npm run lint` = 286 problems = EXACT pre-existing baseline FEAT-001 recorded (my edits add ZERO new lint errors — confirmed 287 momentarily when I used a reset-via-effect, then dropped back to 286 after switching the trend-group reset to a derived value).

=== WHAT CHANGED in app/accuracy-checks/page.tsx (ONLY file touched) ===
Columns/types: added `type GroupColumn = {key;label;short}`; made PLAYER_ACCURACY_COLUMNS `readonly GroupColumn[]` (football, unchanged); added AFL_PLAYER_ACCURACY_COLUMNS (overall/scoring/defence/possession/disposals/other, shorts OVR/SCO/DEF/POS/DIS/OTH) and OVERALL_ONLY_COLUMNS (just overall). Widened `PlayerAccuracyGroupKey` to the union of all football+AFL+overall keys. Added FOOTBALL_GROUP_KEYS / AFL_GROUP_KEYS Sets for shape-valid-key checks.

Reader: REPLACED storedGroupPct with `groupPctForCheck(check,key)` — inspects the STORED SHAPE (`'afl' in pa && pa.afl===true` => AFL; else football via asFootballStored + the existing `!football` guard), returns groupPct(pa.both[key]) only when key is valid for that shape (overall valid on both), else null. So football-shaped/legacy-NULL rows filtered as 'afl' return null -> blank for AFL-only columns (correct until recompute). Added `groupForKey(groups,key)` to index a per-scope GroupAccuracy (football|AFL) by string key, and `type GroupAccuracy = PlayerAccuracy | AflPlayerAccuracy`.

activeColumns memo keyed off sportFilter (football->football5+OVR; afl->AFL5+OVR; all->OVERALL_ONLY). Threaded EVERYWHERE: averageGroups(checks,columns) builds its record over active keys; overallAverages passes activeColumns; sortedSavedChecks `val` default-case returns groupPctForCheck for any active group key (removed the hardcoded overall/passing/... cases); Saved thead/body + CSV header+cells + expanded-row colSpan ((selectedAnalyst?7:8)+activeColumns.length) all iterate activeColumns + groupPctForCheck; History Stat cards iterate activeColumns.

analystComparison & locationComparison memos: sums maps + per-row `groups` record now built over activeColumns via groupPctForCheck (replaced the hardcoded {overall,passing,offensive,defensive,goalkeeper,other} literals with Record<string,number|null>). ComparisonRowData / LocationAnalystRow / LocationRowData `groups` widened to Record<string,number|null>. sortedComparison & location analyst-row sort read r.groups[key] (shape-agnostic).

AnalystComparisonTable + LocationComparisonTable: added a `columns: readonly GroupColumn[]` prop (passed activeColumns at both call sites). Their thead, body cells, empty-state colSpans (3+/4+columns.length), and each component's CSV export now use `columns`.

By-master-fixture: fixtureGroupAccuracy fast path now returns the stored scope object for the correct shape — `'afl' in stored && stored.afl===true` -> stored[scope] (AflPlayerAccuracy), else football path unchanged; legacy XML fallback still computes FOOTBALL PlayerAccuracy for NULL rows (documented backward-compat; renders Overall/football). FixtureRow.groups widened to GroupAccuracy|null. Fixture thead/body/tfoot + sortFixtureRows iterate activeColumns via groupForKey. filter=all uses OVERALL_ONLY_COLUMNS through activeColumns.

Trend chart: selector list driven by `columns`; trend-group reset done WITHOUT a useEffect (would have been a new react-hooks/set-state-in-effect lint error) — instead a derived `effectiveTrendGroup` falls back to 'overall' when the stored trendGroup isn't in activeColumns; trendData, the highlight (trendGroup prop) and the selector all use it. setTrendGroup remains the onClick handler.

alystRecommendations (problem-area panel, not in the explicit step list but it reads per-group part data): generalised to read both-scope groups for EITHER stored shape and iterate activeColumns, so AFL checks now surface recommendations too (previously skipped via asFootballStored).

asFootballStored shim (added by FEAT-001) is still used inside groupPctForCheck/fixtureGroupAccuracy for the football branch. No new deps; Tailwind/table styling unchanged. Non-golden columns (Check #/Date/Match/Analyst/Master by/Category/Ex-Mas/Disp), filters, and the inline category editor untouched.
